_what_this_is: Arm 0 -- our v1.0. RSI-Jev's recipe on a Qwen3-0.6B backbone, run through THEIR code unmodified.
_how_this_is_run: scripts/release_train.py in the reference repository, with --model pointed at the local Qwen3-0.6B and --corpus at the output of THEIR scripts/build_synth_corpus.py. No file of theirs is edited. The two adaptations are a path and a model name, and nothing else.
_why_no_rewrite: An earlier version of this file expressed the same recipe as configuration for a DIFFERENT training program, and that was wrong twice over. It reimplemented 5,166 lines of working code, and its own converter produced 23,319 questions against their 25,859 -- it silently dropped 10% of the corpus, and it ordered boolean options [true, false] where their contract enforces (false, true). Their builder does the domain-level decontamination too, and reports state_overlap_with_typed_decisions: 0. Reusing the script is both less work and more correct than reimplementing it.

fit_extra._note: Left at their defaults unless stated. Every value below is either their default or their v1.0 record, and the comment says which.
fit_extra._v2_1_not_applied: lower_layers_n and lower_layers_lr_scale belong to their v2.1 and are deliberately absent. Arm 0 reproduces v1.0.

_reference._not_comparable: Their numbers came from an H100 with a different kernel stack. They are recorded for orientation and are never differenced against ours.

_ours.corpus: E:/2026-AI4S/corpus_rsijev -- built by their scripts/build_synth_corpus.py: 6,977 cases / 25,859 questions, plus 437 adjacent-domain cases held aside
_ours.seed_order: 17, then 29 and 43. Theirs judges the mean of three and fixed 17 as primary in advance; that order is kept.

_unresolved_before_this_arm_can_run: MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: whether a 0.6B tower trains full-parameter in 12 GB under this recipe. Their defaults assume an H100 80 GB. A probe under a different program reported 11,972 of 12,282 MiB, but that program is not this one and the number does not transfer.
Their fla/Triton stack is pinned to torch 2.7.1+cu128 and this host runs torch 2.10. Whether their code path runs here at all is measured before the arm is launched, not discovered by it.
